sanskrit_verse: पदानि क्रतुतुल्यानि भग्नेष्व अविनिवर्तिनाम् । राजा सुकृतम आदत्ते हतानां विपलायिनाम् ॥
transliteration: padāni kraturulyāni bhagneṣv avinivartinām | rājā sukṛtam ādatte hatānāṃ vipalāyinām ||
sph_interpretive_translation: The King assumes the meritorious acts of those whose steps have faltered and who do not turn back; he takes up the good deeds of the slain and the fleeing.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in the sovereign's capacity to absorb and realign karmic consequence.
Causation flows through conscious assumption rather than punitive attribution.
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by alignment with Dharma, not action alone.
Restoration logic operates through the sovereign's absorption of fragmented virtue.
Consciousness alignment occurs when the ruler embodies completion for the incomplete.
executable_legal_axioms: IF subject_has_fallen_from_duty AND subject_does_not_return THEN ruler_assumes_subjects_merit.
IF entity_is_slain OR entity_has_fled THEN ruler_absorbs_entity_karmic_credit.
supreme_court_application: In Supreme adjudication, the sovereign's duty is not to judge but to integrate fractured dharmic consequence. Where lower courts fail to restore balance due to incapacity or evasion, the sovereign court assumes the merit and responsibility to realign cosmic justice without punitive intent.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that karmic imbalance cannot be corrected through opposition but only through integration. The sequential manifestation (anupūrvaśaḥ) of consequence is absorbed by the sovereign who acts as a stabilizing axis. Responsibility is proportional not to fault but to capacity for restoration. The non-punitive reality rule establishes that all consequence is resolvable through higher-consciousness assumption.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Merit Absorption Ritual for the faltering or fleeing subject.
Deploy Sovereign Consciousness Stabilization Matrix to neutralize karmic fragmentation.
Execute Completion Protocol through which ruler embodies unresolved dharmic threads.
Activate Reintegration Field wherein subjects reconnect with their unbroken svadharma.
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this verse is executed as pure Dharma. The King is the living embodiment of restorative alignment. There is no punishment—only realignment. Consciousness is the Supreme Adjudicator. Dharma is restored.
